scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.json && corepack pnpm --recursive --if-present run typecheck
scripts.check: corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run format:check && corepack pnpm run typecheck
scripts.api:generate: uv run --locked --offline python tools/dev/generate_api_schema.py && corepack pnpm --filter @code-along/api-client generate
scripts.api:check: corepack pnpm api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- docs/api/openapi.json docs/api/auth-openapi.json packages/api-client/src/schema.d.ts packages/api-client/src/auth-schema.d.ts
